subtitle: TBCL 第1級 — 25 scenes, TBLL 6 stages

modules.title: 請問，你是哪國人？
modules.title_py: Qǐng wèn, nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
modules.title_id: Excuse me, where are you from?
modules.scene: A break during language class. Your classmates from different countries ask each other where they are from and which languages they speak.
can_do: Ask and say which country someone is from (你是哪國人？我是印尼人。)
Say which languages I speak (我說中文、英文)
modules.exam_link: Identity questions (哪國人) are a classic opener in 聽力 Part 2. The particles 嗎 and 呢 often distinguish the answers in one-turn Q&A.

lines.py: Dà wén, qǐng wèn nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
lines.id: Dawen, excuse me, where are you from?

lines.zh: 我是印尼人。你是臺灣人嗎？
lines.py: Wǒ shì Yìn ní rén. Nǐ shì Tái wān rén ma?
lines.id: I'm Indonesian. Are you Taiwanese?

lines.zh: 是，我是臺灣人。你會說中文嗎？
lines.py: Shì, wǒ shì Tái wān rén. Nǐ huì shuō Zhōng wén ma?
lines.id: Yes, I'm Taiwanese. Can you speak Mandarin?

lines.py: Wǒ huì shuō Zhōng wén.
lines.id: I can speak Mandarin.

lines.py: Měi měi, tā shì wài guó rén ma?
lines.id: Meimei, is he a foreigner?

lines.py: Shì de, tā shì Měi guó rén.
lines.id: Yes, he's American.

lines.py: Tā ne? Tā shì nǎ guó rén?
lines.id: What about her? Where is she from?

lines.zh: 她是日本人。她說日語和中文。
lines.py: Tā shì Rì běn rén. Tā shuō Rì yǔ hé Zhōng wén.
lines.id: She's Japanese. She speaks Japanese and Mandarin.

lines.py: Nǐ ne? Nǐ shuō Yīng wén ma?
lines.id: What about you? Do you speak English?

lines.py: Wǒ shuō Yīng wén.
lines.id: I speak English.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 他說什麼話？
tasks.why: 中文 = Mandarin. 英文 = English; 日語 = Japanese.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 哪國人 asks for someone's country. B answers with a name, C with a language — same introduction theme, but not the answer.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: A …嗎 question is answered by repeating the verb: 說。 B is about a country, C about oneself (not 他).

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: A …嗎 question is answered 是，我是…。 B & C use the wrong verb (說/叫 + 臺灣人).

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: …，你呢？ = "what about you?" → answer with the same pattern: 我是日本人。

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.
tasks.question: 這位小姐是哪國人？
tasks.why: She answers 我是日本人. 臺灣人 only appears in the man's question — a trap word you hear first.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.question: 小姐會說什麼話？
tasks.why: 我會說日語和中文 — 英文 is not mentioned as a language she speaks (an implied answer to 會說英文嗎). A, C and D contain 英文.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 他說英文。
tasks.why: 他 = he (她 = she; they sound the same, the difference is only in writing). 英文 = English.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: 她 (female) + 說中文. B has the wrong person & language; C has the wrong verb (是 ≠ to speak).

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: a man asks a classmate where they are from

tasks.text: 請問，你是（　）國人？
tasks.why: 哪國人 = from which country. 什麼國人 is not idiomatic; 嗎 always goes at the end of the sentence.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 請問，你是（1）國人？我是印尼人。你（2）？我是臺灣人。你說中文（3）？
tasks.why: (1) 哪國人 = which country. (2) 你呢 = 'what about you?' (3) 嗎 turns a sentence into a yes/no question. 話 does not fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我姓林，我叫林安妮。我是印尼人，我說印尼話、英文，我說中文。
tasks.question: 林安妮是哪國人？
tasks.why: Text: 我是印尼人. She can speak Mandarin, but that does not make her Taiwanese (a 'related but unsupported' distractor).

grammar.explain: Add 嗎 to the end of a statement; the word order does NOT change. Answer by repeating the verb: 你說英文嗎？→ 說。

check.q: Turn it into a question: 他是美國人。

grammar.point: 哪 — which (這/那 come in A03)
grammar.explain: 哪 = 'which', placed where the answer goes: 你是哪國人？→ 我是印尼人。 Sentences with question words like 哪/什麼 do NOT use 嗎.

examples.zh: 他是哪國人？他是美國人。
examples.id: Where is he from? He's American.

supplement.meaning: can (ability; 會說中文 = can speak Mandarin)

supplement.note: Used here in 是的. The main use of 的 (possession: 我的爸爸) is learned in A03.

modules.title: 你家有幾個人？
modules.title_py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
modules.title_id: How many people are in your family?
modules.scene: The family photo chat continues: you count your family members, then ask Mr Chen about his children.
can_do: Say how many people are in your family (我家有五個人)
Use the measure word 個 and tell 兩 and 二 apart
Say you don't have something (我沒有妹妹)
modules.exam_link: Number + measure word is the basis of 聽力 Part 1 (choose the picture with the right number). The difference between 兩 and 二 is often tested in 閱讀 Part 4.

lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
lines.id: Dawen, how many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 我家有五個人。有爸爸、媽媽、哥哥、姊姊，和我。
lines.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ ge rén. Yǒu bà ba, mā ma, gē ge, jiě jie, hé wǒ.
lines.id: There are five people in my family. There are my dad, mum, older brother, older sister and me.

lines.py: Nǐ yǒu mèi mei ma?
lines.id: Do you have a younger sister?

lines.zh: 我沒有妹妹。你家有幾個人？
lines.py: Wǒ méi yǒu mèi mei. Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
lines.id: I don't have a younger sister. How many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 我家有四個人。我有一個弟弟。
lines.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge rén. Wǒ yǒu yí ge dì di.
lines.id: There are four of us. I have a younger brother.

lines.py: Chén xiān shēng, nín yǒu hái zi ma?
lines.id: Mr Chen, do you have children?

lines.zh: 有，我有三個孩子，兩個兒子，一個女兒。
lines.py: Yǒu, wǒ yǒu sān ge hái zi, liǎng ge ér zi, yí ge nǚ ér.
lines.id: Yes, I have three children: two sons and one daughter.

lines.py: Nín tài tai shì Tái wān rén ma?
lines.id: Is your wife Taiwanese?

lines.py: Shì, tā shì Tái wān rén.
lines.id: Yes, she's Taiwanese.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 她有幾個孩子？
tasks.why: Two children → 兩個孩子. Before a measure word, use 兩, not 二.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 他們家有幾個孩子？
tasks.why: Three children → 三個. Train your ear: 三 sān, 兩 liǎng, 四 sì.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 他有兒子嗎？
options: 他沒有兒子，有兩個女兒。
他有一個兒子、一個女兒。
tasks.why: The picture only shows two girls → 沒有兒子，有兩個女兒. A and C mention a son.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 幾個人 → answer with number + 個 + 人. B is missing 有/個; C answers with a nationality.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: No older brother → 沒有. B: answers 有 but mentions 姊姊 — it doesn't follow. C is ungrammatical.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 沒有，我有兩個姊姊，一個弟弟。

tasks.question: 這位小姐有幾個姊姊？
tasks.why: 兩個姊姊. 一個 is the number of 弟弟 — a mixed-up-detail distractor.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 我家有五個人：爸爸、媽媽、兩個哥哥和我。

tasks.question: 小姐有幾個哥哥？
tasks.why: 兩個哥哥. D = the size of the whole family. A & C are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 我家有五個人。
tasks.why: 五個人 = five people.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: Three daughters → 三個女兒. B has the wrong number; C the wrong kind (兒子 = son).

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 陳先生有一個（　）。
tasks.why: Son = 兒子. 女兒 = daughter; 太太 = wife.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我家有（1）個人。我有兩（2）哥哥，我（3）姊姊。
tasks.why: (1) a number. (2) 兩個 — the measure word is required. (3) 沒有 = not have. 二 is not used before a measure word (二個 ✗).

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 陳先生家有六個人：陳先生、陳太太，他們有四個孩子——三個兒子，一個女兒。
tasks.question: 陳先生有幾個女兒？
tasks.why: 一個女兒. 三個 = sons, 四個 = all the children — a 'partly true' distractor.

grammar.point: 數 + 量 — number + measure word
grammar.explain: Between a number and a noun there must be a measure word (量詞). 個 is the most common. For 'two' before a 量詞 use 兩: 兩個人, not 二個人.

examples.id: There are five people in my family.

grammar.point: 稱數法 — how to say numbers
grammar.explain: Mandarin numbers are built like arithmetic: 十一 (10+1), 二十 (2×10), 二十五 (2×10+5). When counting or saying a number use 二; before a 量詞 use 兩.

pendukung.meaning: to have; there is (還有 = and also)

modules.title: 桌子上有什麼？
modules.title_py: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu shén me?
modules.scene: Meimei goes into Dawen's room and asks where things are; then Dawen looks for his younger sister at home.
can_do: Say where things are with position words (桌子上, 床前面, 門旁邊)
Tell 'X is at Y' (在) apart from 'at Y there is X' (有)
modules.exam_link: Where things are in a room is the MOST frequent picture question in 聽力 Part 1 and 閱讀 Parts 1–3 (上/下/旁邊/前面).

lines.zh: 大文，你的房間裡有什麼？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de fáng jiān lǐ yǒu shén me?
lines.id: Dawen, what's in your room?

lines.zh: 有床、桌子、椅子，還有一個電視。
lines.py: Yǒu chuáng, zhuō zi, yǐ zi, hái yǒu yí ge diàn shì.
lines.id: There's a bed, a table, a chair, and also a TV.

lines.py: Nǐ de diàn shì zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where is your TV?

lines.py: Diàn shì zài zhuō zi shàng.
lines.id: The TV is on the table.

lines.py: Yǐ zi zài chuáng páng biān ma?
lines.id: Is the chair next to the bed?

lines.py: Bù, yǐ zi zài zhuō zi qián miàn.
lines.id: No, the chair is in front of the desk.

lines.py: Mā ma, Xiǎo wén zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Mum, where's Xiaowen?

lines.py: Tā zài fáng jiān lǐ, zài chuáng shàng.
lines.id: She's in her room, on the bed.

lines.py: Tā kàn diàn shì ma?
lines.id: Is she watching TV?

lines.py: Shì, tā xǐ huān kàn diàn shì.
lines.id: Yes, she likes watching TV.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 電視在哪裡？
tasks.why: 桌子上 = on the table. 上/下 are often paired as distractors.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a chair next to the table

tasks.question: 椅子在哪裡？
tasks.why: 旁邊 = next to. 上 = on/above; 下 = under.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a TV in front of the bed

tasks.question: 電視在哪裡？
tasks.why: 前面 = in front. 床上 = on the bed; 旁邊 = next to.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: X 在 哪裡 → X 在 + place. B answers 'what is on the chair' (the 有 pattern); C does not give a location.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 在哪裡 asks for a location → answer 在 + place. B does not give a location; C makes no sense.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.
tasks.question: 桌子在哪裡？
tasks.why: 桌子在門旁邊. 床前面 is where the TV is.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.question: 媽媽在哪裡？
tasks.why: 你看，在門口！ A: already checked, not there. C & D are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 桌子下有一個球。

options.label: a ball next to the chair

tasks.why: 桌子下 = under the table.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: two chairs next to the table

tasks.why: Position: next to (旁邊), object: chair (椅子).

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 大文（　）椅子。
tasks.why: 拿 = to take/hold. 住 = to live; 在 = to be at.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我的房間（1）有一個電視。電視（2）桌子上，椅子在桌子（3）。
tasks.why: (1) 房間裡 = in the room. (2) thing + 在 + place. (3) the position word comes after the reference object. 有 is wrong in (2) because the subject is a thing, not a place.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我的房間不大。門旁邊是床，床前面有電視。桌子在床旁邊，椅子在桌子下。
tasks.question: 電視在哪裡？
tasks.why: 床前面有電視. The other options are the locations of other things in the same text (mixed up).

grammar.point: 地點表達 — saying where things are
grammar.pattern: Thing + 在 + reference + 上/下/裡/前面/旁邊
grammar.explain: The position word goes AFTER the reference object (the opposite of English 'on the table' = 桌子上). Two patterns: 電視在桌子上 (the TV is on the table) and 桌子上有電視 (on the table there is a TV) — the 有 pattern starts with the place.

examples.id: The chair is in front of the table.
There's a TV in the room.

check.q: 'There's a bed next to the door' =

pendukung.meaning: to have; there is (還有 = and also)
also; still (還有 = and there is also)
to be at; in the middle of (doing)
to look; to watch; to read

modules.title: 我每天七點起床。
modules.title_py: Wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
modules.title_id: I get up at seven every day.
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei compare their daily routines: when they get up, what they do from morning to evening, and when they go to bed.
can_do: Say and ask the time (現在幾點？九點二十分)
Describe a daily routine in the order 'who + when + activity'
Tell the parts of the day apart: 早上、中午、下午、晚上
modules.exam_link: Time & schedules are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Part 1 (choose the right time) and Part 3 (who does what at what time).

lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
lines.id: Dawen, what time do you get up every day?

lines.zh: 我每天早上七點起床。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: I get up at seven in the morning. And you?

lines.zh: 我六點半起床。我早上運動。
lines.py: Wǒ liù diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng. Wǒ zǎo shang yùn dòng.
lines.id: I get up at half past six. In the morning I exercise.

lines.zh: 你好早！你晚上幾點睡覺？
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo zǎo! Nǐ wǎn shàng jǐ diǎn shuì jiào?
lines.id: So early! What time do you go to bed at night?

lines.py: Shí yī diǎn. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: Eleven. And you?

lines.py: Wǒ shí èr diǎn shuì jiào.
lines.id: I go to bed at twelve.

lines.py: Měi měi, xiàn zài jǐ diǎn?
lines.id: Meimei, what time is it now?

lines.py: Xiàn zài jiǔ diǎn èr shí fēn.
lines.id: It's twenty past nine.

lines.py: Nǐ xià wǔ yào zuò shén me?
lines.id: What are you going to do this afternoon?

lines.zh: 我下午要畫畫，晚上也要看電影。
lines.py: Wǒ xià wǔ yào huà huà, wǎn shang yě yào kàn diàn yǐng.
lines.id: This afternoon I'm going to draw, and in the evening I'm also going to watch a film.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 現在幾點？
tasks.why: 七點半 = 7:30. 六點半 (6:30) is the trap: 半 attaches to the hour that is said — just like 'half past'.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 現在幾點？
tasks.why: 十點 = ten o'clock exactly. 十點半 = 10:30; 兩點 = 2:00.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 你每天晚上幾點睡覺？
tasks.why: 睡覺 = to sleep; 十一點 = 11 o'clock. A has the wrong activity (起床 = to get up); B the wrong time.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 幾點 → say the time. B does not give a time; C mixes up 'o'clock' with 'duration' (小時).

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 幾點 asks for the time. B answers with a duration (小時); C does not answer.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 十一點。我哥哥十二點睡覺。

tasks.question: 這位小姐幾點睡覺？
tasks.why: She herself goes to bed at 11. 12 o'clock belongs to her older sibling.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.question: 這位先生幾點起床？
tasks.why: 我六點半起床. A = the woman's getting-up time. C & D are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 現在下午兩點半。

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: an alarm clock ringing in the morning

tasks.why: A morning alarm → 早上起床.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 現在七（　）。
tasks.why: O'clock = 點. 分 = minute; 天 = day.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我每天早上七點（1），晚上十一點（2）。現在十點五十（3）。
tasks.why: (1) morning → 起床. (2) night → 睡覺. (3) 十點五十分 = 10:50. 小時 expresses duration, not minutes on the clock.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我叫安妮。我每天早上六點半起床，七點運動。中午我看電視，下午畫畫，晚上十點睡覺。
tasks.question: 安妮幾點睡覺？
tasks.why: 晚上十點睡覺. 六點半 is when she gets up, 七點 when she exercises; 十二點 is not mentioned.

recycle.id: Time pattern (A05): hour (點) → minutes (分), from big to small.
The time expression goes BEFORE the verb: who + when + activity.

pendukung.meaning: to do; to make (做什麼 = do what)
to look; to watch; to read

modules.title: 這個多少錢？
modules.scene: Dawen buys stationery at a shop near campus: asking prices, comparing cheap/expensive, paying and getting change.
can_do: Ask the price (這個多少錢？) and say prices with 塊/元
Work out the total (一共) and get change (找你…)
Say something is expensive/cheap (好貴！很便宜)
modules.exam_link: Shopping & prices are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–3 and 閱讀 Parts 1–2. Questions about the total price (一共) and change appear in almost every paper.

lines.py: Xiān shēng, qǐng wèn zhè ge duō shǎo qián?
lines.id: Excuse me, how much is this?

lines.py: Zhè ge yì bǎi èr shí kuài.
lines.id: This is a hundred and twenty dollars.

lines.py: Hǎo guì! Nà ge ne?
lines.id: That's so expensive! What about that one?

lines.py: Nà ge pián yí, bā shí kuài.
lines.id: That one's cheap — eighty.

lines.py: Wǒ mǎi liǎng ge. Yí gòng duō shǎo qián?
lines.id: I'll take two. How much altogether?

lines.py: Yí gòng yì bǎi liù shí kuài.
lines.id: A hundred and sixty altogether.

lines.py: Gěi nǐ liǎng bǎi kuài.
lines.id: Here's two hundred.

lines.py: Zhǎo nǐ sì shí kuài. Xiè xie!
lines.id: Forty back. Thank you!

lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ mǎi shén me dōng xi?
lines.id: Dawen, what did you buy?

lines.zh: 我買筆和紙。這個店的東西很便宜。
lines.py: Wǒ mǎi bǐ hé zhǐ. Zhè ge diàn de dōng xi hěn pián yí.
lines.id: I bought pens and paper. Things in this shop are cheap.

lines.py: Nǐ de qián gòu ma?
lines.id: Do you have enough money?

lines.py: Gòu, wǒ zhǐ mǎi yì diǎn dōng xi.
lines.id: Yes, I only bought a few things.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 一共多少錢？
tasks.why: 三百五十 = 350. Numbers that sound alike (530, 53) are a favourite distractor.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 這個多少錢？
tasks.why: 一百二十 = 120. 一百 = 100; 兩百二十 = 220.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 你去哪裡？
tasks.why: 買東西 = to go shopping. B and C are other places/activities.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 多少錢 → give a price. B and C are about shopping but don't give a number.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 多少錢 asks for a price → answer with 塊. B gives the number of items.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.
tasks.question: 這位先生一共要給多少錢？
tasks.why: 3 × 20 = 60. 二十 is the unit price — a typical question that makes you calculate rather than repeat a number.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 一個一百塊，兩個一百五十塊。

tasks.question: 這位小姐一共要給多少錢？
tasks.why: Two = 一百五十塊. A = the price of one. C = 100 × 2 (a calculation trap). D is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 這杯咖啡五十塊。

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: 找(錢) = to give change.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 這個十塊，很（　）！
tasks.why: Only 10 dollars → 便宜 (cheap).

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 這個多少（1）？九十五塊。我買兩個，（2）一百九十塊。我給他兩百塊，他（3）我十塊。
tasks.why: (1) 多少錢. (2) total → 一共. (3) change → 找. 便宜 does not fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read this price list, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 咖啡一杯：六十元　茶一杯：四十元　包子一個：二十五元
tasks.question: 一杯咖啡和一個包子，一共多少錢？
tasks.why: 60 + 25 = 85. 元 is the written form of 塊 (e.g. on price lists).

recycle.zh: 給你兩百塊。找你四十塊。

modules.title: 今天好熱！
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei chat about the weather in Taiwan and Indonesia, then plan a trip to the mountains.
can_do: Describe the weather: 熱、冷、下雨、風很大
Ask about the weather (天氣怎麼樣？)
Say what is the most … with 最
modules.exam_link: Weather is a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Part 1 (choose the weather picture) and 閱讀 Part 1.

lines.py: Jīn tiān hǎo rè!
lines.id: It's so hot today!

lines.zh: 對，臺灣的天氣很熱。印尼熱不熱？
lines.py: Duì, Tái wān de tiān qì hěn rè. Yìn ní rè bú rè?
lines.id: Yes, Taiwan's weather is hot. Is Indonesia hot?

lines.zh: 印尼也很熱。臺灣一月很冷嗎？
lines.py: Yìn ní yě hěn rè. Tái wān yī yuè hěn lěng ma?
lines.id: Indonesia is hot too. Is Taiwan cold in January?

lines.py: Yī yuè hěn lěng, yě cháng cháng xià yǔ.
lines.id: January is cold, and it often rains.

dialogs.title_id: Talking about going to the mountains

lines.zh: 大文，明天我們一起去山上吧！山上的空氣很好。
lines.py: Dà wén, míng tiān wǒ men yì qǐ qù shān shàng ba! Shān shàng de kōng qì hěn hǎo.
lines.id: Dawen, let's go up the mountain together tomorrow! The air up there is great.

lines.py: Míng tiān xià yǔ ma?
lines.id: Will it rain tomorrow?

lines.zh: 明天不下雨，可是風很大。
lines.py: Míng tiān bú xià yǔ, kě shì fēng hěn dà.
lines.id: It won't rain tomorrow, but it'll be very windy.

lines.py: Nà ge shān gāo bù gāo?
lines.id: Is the mountain high?

lines.zh: 不高，山上的花也很漂亮！
lines.py: Bù gāo, shān shàng de huā yě hěn piào liang!
lines.id: It's not high, and the flowers on the mountain are pretty too!

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 今天天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 下雨 = to rain. The distractors are from the same weather category.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 今天天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 冷 = cold. 熱 = hot; 下雨 = to rain.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 山上有什麼？
tasks.why: 山上的花 = flowers on the mountain. A and C talk about the weather.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 天氣怎麼樣 → describe the weather. B answers with a day; C with how he feels.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 會…嗎 → answer with 會/可能會.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.
tasks.question: 明天天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 不下雨，可是風很大. A is negated; C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.question: 明天的天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 明天會下雨…很冷. A = TODAY's weather. C & D don't match.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 今天風很大。
tasks.why: 風很大 = it's very windy.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: Hot = 熱.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 今天（　）雨。
tasks.why: It is raining = 下雨.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 今天（1）很好，不冷也不（2）。山上的（3）很好。
tasks.why: (1) 天氣很好. (2) the partner of 冷 → 熱. (3) in the mountains → 空氣很好. 雨 doesn't fit (下雨 is the verb).

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 臺灣七月最熱，一月很冷，也常常下雨。山上的空氣很好，天氣不熱。
tasks.question: 臺灣幾月最熱？
tasks.why: 七月最熱. 一月 is mentioned as a cold month — a reversal distractor.

recycle.id: 最 + adjective = the most …; location (A09): 山上.
